title: Maze Runner (BFS)

links.title: LeetCode: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix

hints: Shortest path where every step costs 1 = breadth-first search. DFS finds A path, not the shortest one.
Use a std::queue of positions and a distance grid initialised to -1 (which doubles as the 'visited' marker).
Mark a cell as visited WHEN YOU PUSH IT, not when you pop it, or the same cell enters the queue many times.
Neighbours: loop over const int dr[] = {1,-1,0,0}, dc[] = {0,0,1,-1} and check the bounds before reading the grid.
